name: Kneading Trough
overview: The kneading trough, mentioned in Exodus and Deuteronomy, symbolizes daily provision and sustenance for God's people. In Exodus, kneading troughs are noted as places invaded by plagues, reflecting the disruption of ordinary life under judgment, while also representing the preparation of bread, a basic necessity. Deuteronomy contrasts blessing and curse upon the kneading troughs, highlighting their association with God's covenantal blessings or discipline depending on obedience. Thus, the kneading trough serves as a tangible reminder of God's care and the consequences tied to His covenant.
